sentences.en: Utopia trend is very inspiring by sensorial design and sensitive architecture. Here are some projects and realizations, which are light and strong at the same time.

sentences.en: The sensorial education plays an important role in the development of mentally retarded children.

sentences.en: The Contact Series gives a dynamic and sensorial experience to the visually impaired user by adding a tactile element in the form of braille lettering to everyday objects.
sentences.vi: Dòng Contact Series mang đến trải nghiệm năng động và nhạy bén cho người dùng khiếm thị bằng cách thêm yếu tố xúc giác dưới dạng ký tự chữ nổi vào các đồ vật hàng ngày.

sentences.en: Sometimes people think there is something magic about sensorial math materials.

sentences.en: Finally the development trend at the aspect of sensorial and energy of IBPL is pointed out.
